summary: Learn enterprise IoT architecture, security, and rollout planning in 5 days. Build practical templates and dashboards. Enquire now.
lede: Enterprise Internet of Things (IoT) training helps operations, IT, and analytics professionals plan and govern connected-device deployments. It covers mapping edge-to-cloud data flows, selecting sensors and connectivity such as MQTT and CoAP, and planning device security and telemetry governance. Exercises include drafting a rollout plan and defining monitoring needs to support business use-case assessment and technical and operational decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to plan, deploy, and govern enterprise IoT solutions across operations, IT, and analytics functions.
audience: Facilities or Maintenance Manager using IoT alerts
prerequisites: You should have working familiarity with enterprise operations, networking basics, and data workflows. No programming background is required, but it will help if you can read simple device logic, interpret dashboard outputs, and work with structured data in spreadsheets or BI tools. Prior exposure to cloud services, sensor systems, or OT/IT environments is useful but not mandatory. Bring a laptop for architecture exercises, template completion, and any digital mapping work.
